description: Easy to use personal finance manager: rich functionality and Open Source My Expenses is your ultimate, privacy-friendly personal finance manager—giving you total control over daily expense tracking, budgeting, and investment portfolios with open-source transparency. Key Features: • Daily Expense & Budget Tracking: Effortlessly keep tabs on income and expenses on your phone or tablet. Create budgets, split transactions, and set up recurring transaction plans. • Investment & Portfolio Management: Track stock, crypto, or custom asset portfolios, monitor price history, and manage multi-currency investments in real time. • Bank Integration & Reconciliation: Connect directly to supported banks via FinTS or reconcile transactions manually against your bank statements for pixel-perfect balance tracking. • Smart Receipt Scanning (OCR): Automatically extract transaction details from photo receipts using advanced optical character recognition. • Web Interface for Desktop: Access and manage your transactions from any web browser on your local network. • Powerful Analytics: Visualize spending trends, distribution pie charts, and historical reports with customizable dynamic graphs. • Flexible Sync & Data Control: Export and import data easily in QIF and CSV formats. Sync seamlessly across devices using WebDAV, Nextcloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive with client certificate support. • Privacy & Security First: Open-source transparency, password or biometric lock screen security, and encrypted database protection. Unlock Premium Features: • Contrib Key: Highlights include unlocking unlimited accounts, unlimited recurring plans, PDF list exports, category distribution charts, and more. • Extended Key: Includes all Contrib features, plus automated cloud synchronization, and advanced CSV import rules. • Professional Key: Includes all Extended features, plus investment & portfolio tracking, history charts, budget monitoring, receipt OCR scanning, local web desktop interface, direct bank sync (Germany), and more. Permissions Transparency: • Calendar: Recurrent plans are saved to a dedicated local calendar or any calendar you assign. • Internet: Anonymous usage tracking (opt-in), cloud synchronization and crash reports (opt-in). Take control of your money and net worth today with My Expenses!
